text:
We checked “Café <Menu> & "Specials"” and found one issue in the InDesign file that is likely causing the problems in Frontify. Here’s what to change:

1. Kerning isn’t set to Metrics
Frontify spaces letters using the font’s own kerning (Metrics).
Where: paragraph styles “Zeta”, “2”, “élan” and 3 more, used on pages 1–2
• In the paragraph style, go to Basic Character Formats and set Kerning to Metrics.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
